where: created_date in 2020..2026 (one query per year) AND agency not in ('HPD', 'DOB')
candidate_rule: seen at least min_count times over the period and not on the step-4 allowlist; agencies HPD and DOB never

manual_reject_reasons.third_party_social_services: describes whether an individual accepted or refused outreach, housing or mental-health services

review_notes: Picklist fields (agency, complaint_type, descriptor, descriptor_2, location_type) hold city-maintained categories and codes; every candidate was read. resolution_description holds agency template text; every candidate that passed the automatic screen was read in full. Admitted: generic agency outcomes that name no person, address, business, vehicle or date and tell no story about the reporter. Agency phone numbers and URLs in templates trip the contact and URL screens; those templates stay withheld rather than carving out exceptions. Mis-encoded characters (for example 'â') are kept verbatim as published.
